connector.name: Max Messenger
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for MAX Messenger by VK. 21 tools: messages, media, buttons, members, events.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-max-messenger. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the woyaxnini account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
